errors.evidence: The machine-generated description does not mention that the chart represents the share of Russian imports of selected industrial raw materials in percentage terms.

The machine-generated description does not explicitly state that the vertical axis is labeled with '%' and scaled from 0 to 30 with tick marks at intervals of 5.
